hints.title: Monotonic Peak Search
hints.text: The total array sum is strictly increasing with the target value placed at the given index.

hints.title: Pyramidal Sum Formula
hints.text: Values decrease by 1 each step away from index until reaching 1, forming arithmetic progressions on left and right sides.

hints.title: Binary Search Over Answers
hints.text: Binary search the peak value between 1 and maxSum, calculating minimal sum required in constant time.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: maxSum is upper bound on sum
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Incrementing the peak one by one takes linear time in maxSum, which is up to 10^9.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Binary search over values evaluates the closed-form arithmetic sum formula in logarithmic time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate computes left and right triangular sums accurately handling saturation at 1.
